name: Mention Notifier
description: Sends external HTTP notifications for configured Mattermost mentions.

settings.help_text: Enable external notifications for monitored posts.
Comma-separated Mattermost team IDs. Leave empty to allow all teams.
Comma-separated Mattermost channel IDs. Leave empty to allow all channels.
Choose how notifications are delivered. Generic posts JSON to Notification endpoint. KavehNegar sends an SMS via the KavehNegar REST API.
HTTP or HTTPS endpoint that receives one POST request per matched mention. Used only when Provider is Generic HTTP webhook.
Optional bearer token sent as the Authorization header. Used only when Provider is Generic HTTP webhook.

Your KavehNegar API key, from https://panel.kavenegar.com/client/setting/account. Required when Provider is KavehNegar SMS. Can also be set via the KAVENEGAR_API_KEY environment variable, which takes priority over this field.
Optional. Defaults to https://api.kavenegar.com/v1 if left blank. Can also be set via the KAVENEGAR_API_URL environment variable, which takes priority over this field.

Optional. The name of a pre-approved template in your KavehNegar panel (e.g. MattermostMentionNotify). When set, notifications use KavehNegar's faster verify/lookup API with this template instead of a plain SMS, and KavehNegar sender line / SMS message template below are ignored.
Optional. The sender line/number configured on your KavehNegar account. Leave blank to use your account default.
Optional. Use {{user}} and {{message}} as placeholders. If left blank, a default template is used.
Path to the username-to-number CSV. A relative path is resolved relative to the plugin executable.
HTTP request timeout from 1 to 120 seconds.
When enabled, mentioning a Mattermost Group (e.g. @on-call) notifies every member of that group, in addition to plain @username mentions.

Appends verbose diagnostics (tagged messages, extracted mentions, numbers, and provider response codes) to a log file in plain text. Only enable while actively troubleshooting - see the README security note before enabling in production.
Optional. Defaults to mention-notifier-debug.log beside the plugin executable if left blank. Only used when Debug logging is enabled.
